author: Eric Jorgenson
text: Seek wealth, not money or status. Wealth is having assets that earn while you sleep.
note: Section: Understand How Wealth Is Created

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: You’re not going to get rich renting out your time. You must own equity—a piece of a business—to gain your financial freedom.
note: Section: Understand How Wealth Is Created

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: You will get rich by giving society what it wants but does not yet know how to get. At scale.
note: Section: Understand How Wealth Is Created

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: Specific knowledge is knowledge you cannot be trained for. If society can train you, it can train someone else and replace you.
note: Section: Find and Build Specific Knowledge

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: Building specific knowledge will feel like play to you but will look like work to others.
note: Section: Find and Build Specific Knowledge

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: Escape competition through authenticity.
note: Section: Find and Build Specific Knowledge

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: All the returns in life, whether in wealth, relationships, or knowledge, come from compound interest.
note: Section: Play Long-Term Games with Long-Term People

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: Embrace accountability, and take business risks under your own name. Society will reward you with responsibility, equity, and leverage.
note: Section: Take on Accountability

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: Code and media are permissionless leverage. They’re the leverage behind the newly rich. You can create software and media that works for you while you sleep.
note: Section: Find a Position of Leverage

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: Forget rich versus poor, white-collar versus blue. It’s now leveraged versus un-leveraged.
note: Section: Find a Position of Leverage

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: Earn with your mind, not your time.
note: Section: Find a Position of Leverage

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: I would love to be paid purely for my judgment, not for any work. I want a robot, capital, or computer to do the work, but I want to be paid for my judgment.
note: Section: Get Paid for Your Judgment

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: Value your time at an hourly rate, and ruthlessly spend to save time at that rate. You will never be worth more than you think you’re worth.
note: Section: Prioritize and Focus

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: In 1,000 parallel universes, you want to be wealthy in 999 of them. You don’t want to be wealthy in the fifty of them where you got lucky, so we want to factor luck out of it.
note: Section: How to Get Lucky

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: Hard work is really overrated. How hard you work matters a lot less in the modern economy.
note: Section: Judgment

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: My definition of wisdom is knowing the long-term consequences of your actions. Wisdom applied to external problems is judgment.
note: Section: Judgment

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: In an age of leverage, one correct decision can win everything.
note: Section: Judgment

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: If you can’t explain it to a child, then you don’t know it.
note: Section: How to Think Clearly

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: The number one thing clouding us from being able to see reality is we have preconceived notions of the way it should be.
note: Section: How to Think Clearly

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: What you feel tells you nothing about the facts—it merely tells you something about your estimate of the facts.
note: Section: How to Think Clearly

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: Any belief you took in a package (ex. Democrat, Catholic, American) is suspect and should be re-evaluated from base principles.
note: Section: Shed Your Identity to See Reality

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: The moment you tell somebody something dishonest, you’ve lied to yourself. Then you’ll start believing your own lie, which will disconnect you from reality and take you down the wrong road.
note: Section: Learn the Skills of Decision-Making

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: If you cannot decide, the answer is no.
note: Section: Collect Mental Models

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: Simple heuristic: If you’re evenly split on a difficult decision, take the path more painful in the short term.
note: Section: Collect Mental Models

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: Read what you love until you love to read.
note: Section: Learn to Love to Read

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: The number of books completed is a vanity metric. As you know more, you leave more books unfinished.
note: Section: Learn to Love to Read

author: Eric Jorgenson
text: If you start with the originals as your foundations, then you have enough of a worldview and understanding that you won’t fear any book.
note: Section: Learn to Love to Read
